Good questions. Straight answers.

BEFORE YOU GET SORTED.

Is this 90 posts?

No. You receive 39 social posts—three per week for 13 weeks—plus 13 separate Facebook group posts. The calendar spreads the content across roughly 90 days.

Will you post it for me?

The pack is self-service. You customise and publish the content. The optional £69 upgrade covers personalising the graphics and captions, not managing or scheduling your pages. Want us to handle posting? Explore GetMySocials ↗

Do I need Canva Pro?

The pack is intended for use with a free Canva account. You’ll add your own logo, photos and details. The quick-start guide explains the process.

How do I get the files?

Once delivery is live, a confirmed £29 payment will trigger an email with access to your selected trade’s pack. If you buy the branding upgrade, you’ll also complete a business brief for the personalised files.

Can I start at any time?

Yes. The core calendar is undated. Start at week one whenever you’re ready, and adjust posts to suit your services, weather and availability.

Are the photos and examples from real customers?

The website artwork and branding examples are illustrative. Use your own genuine job photos and real customer reviews when customising the pack.

Can I use it for more than one business?

The pack is for one business’s own marketing. It cannot be resold, shared as a template pack or used to provide content services to other businesses.

Will this guarantee more enquiries?

No. It helps you plan and create consistent content. Enquiries depend on your audience, offer, work, local demand and how you use the pack.
